lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa jugataa jeeu jugah jug jogee param ta(n)t mahi joga(n) ||
lines.translation: O father, the soul which is united in union as a Yogi, remains united in the supreme essence throughout the ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nira(n)jan paaiaa giaan kaaiaa ras bhoga(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who has obtained the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord - his body enjoys the pleasure of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਉ ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: siv nagaree mahi aasan baisau kalap tiaagee baada(n) ||
lines.translation: In the Lord's City, he sits in his Yogic posture, and he forsakes his desires and conflicts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਦੰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: si(n)ngee sabad sadaa dhun sohai ahinis poorai naada(n) ||2||
lines.translation: The sound of the horn ever rings out its beautiful melody, and day and night, he is filled with the sound current of the Naad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: pat veechaar giaan mat da(n)daa varatamaan bibhoota(n) ||
lines.translation: My cup is reflective meditation, and spiritual wisdom is my walking stick; to dwell in the Lord's Presence is the ashes I apply to my body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਤੀਤੰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har keerat raharaas hamaaree guramukh pa(n)th ateeta(n) ||3||
lines.translation: The Praise of the Lord is my occupation; and to live as Gurmukh is my pure religion. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਮਿਆ ਨਾਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagalee jot hamaaree sa(n)miaa naanaa varan aneka(n) ||
lines.translation: My arm-rest is to see the Lord's Light in all, although their forms and colors are so numerous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੰ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee paarabraham liv eka(n) ||4||3||37||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: love only the Supreme Lord God. ||4||3||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: guR kar giaan dhiaan kar dhaavai kar karanee kas paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Make spiritual wisdom your molasses, and meditation your scented flowers; let good deeds be the herbs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਠੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਾ ਪੋਚਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਸਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaathee bhavan prem kaa pochaa it ras amiu chuaaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Let devotional faith be the distilling fire, and your love the ceramic cup. Thus the sweet nectar of life is distilled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa man matavaaro naam ras peevai sahaj ra(n)g rach rahiaa ||
lines.translation: O Baba, the mind is intoxicated with the Naam, drinking in its Nectar. It remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis banee prem liv laagee sabad anaahad gahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, remaining attached to the Love of the Lord, the celestial music of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa saach piaalaa sahaje tisahi peeaae jaa kau nadar kare ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Lord naturally gives the cup of Truth, to the one upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਛੂਛੈ ਭਾਉ ਧਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit kaa vaapaaree hovai kiaa mad chhoochhai bhaau dhare ||2||
lines.translation: One who trades in this Nectar - how could he ever love the wine of the world? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee saakhee a(n)mrit baanee peevat hee paravaan bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Teachings of the Guru, the Ambrosial Bani - drinking them in, one becomes acceptable and renowned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dar darasan kaa preetam hovai mukat baiku(n)thai karai kiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Unto the one who loves the Lord's Court, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, of what use is liberation or paradise? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: siphatee rataa sad bairaagee jooai janam na haarai ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Praises, one is forever a Bairaagee, a renunciate, and one's life is not lost in the gamble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਖੀਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee kheevaa a(n)mrit dhaarai ||4||4||38||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: drink in the intoxicating nectar of the Lord. ||4||4||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਰਾਸਾਨ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਹਿੰਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: khuraasaan khasamaanaa keeaa hi(n)dusataan daraaiaa ||
lines.translation: Having attacked Khuraasaan, Baabar terrified Hindustan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapai dos na deee karataa jam kar mugal chaRaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself does not take the blame, but has sent the Mugal as the messenger of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਕਰਲਾਣੇ ਤੈਂ ਕੀ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: etee maar paee karalaane tai(n) kee darad na aaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: There was so much slaughter that the people screamed. Didn't You feel compassion, Lord? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karataa too(n) sabhanaa kaa soee ||
lines.translation: O Creator Lord, You are the Master of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: je sakataa sakate kau maare taa man ros na hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If some powerful man strikes out against another man, then no one feels any grief in their mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੈ ਵਗੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਸਾ ਪੁਰਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakataa seehu maare pai vagai khasamai saa purasaaee ||
lines.translation: But if a powerful tiger attacks a flock of sheep and kills them, then its master must answer for it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਕੁਤਂੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan vigaaR vigoe kuta(n)ee muiaa saar na kaaee ||
lines.translation: This priceless country has been laid waste and defiled by dogs, and no one pays any attention to the dead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape joR vichhoRe aape vekh teree vadiaaee ||2||
lines.translation: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; I gaze upon Your Glorious Greatness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਸਾਦ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko naau dharaae vadaa saad kare man bhaane ||
lines.translation: One may give himself a great name, and revel in the pleasures of the mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਕੀੜਾ ਆਵੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਚੁਗੈ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasamai nadaree keeRaa aavai jete chugai daane ||
lines.translation: but in the Eyes of the Lord and Master, he is just a worm, for all the corn that he eats.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥੩॥੫॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae naanak naam vakhaane ||3||5||39||
lines.translation: Only one who dies to his ego while yet alive, obtains the blessings, O Nanak, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||3||5||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 2 mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har darasan paavai vadabhaag ||
lines.translation: The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained by great good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sachai bairaag ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, true detachment is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khat darasan varatai varataaraa ||
lines.translation: The six systems of philosophy are pervasive,
